scientific_integrity: The continuous Euler-Poisson-Darboux beta density is prior work by Garra and Orsingher (arXiv:1411.0648). The newly established mathematical statement is the independent-Bernoulli calendar-time functional limit for all k p_k -> c and its explicit limiting two-time covariance, c=1/2 aging boundary and Binder prediction. Analytical rather than finite computational evidence establishes universality.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional independent calendar-time reversals, fixed positive limit of k p_k, compact-time functional convergence. Long-lag covariance threshold is proved only for the limiting process with N first taken to infinity. No independent scientific audit, and implicit coverage by a general rare-switch invariance theorem is possible.
title: Universal critical aging limit and covariance transition in persistent walks
